description: Defines adapter classes for PDCP to SDAP, E1AP, F1-U, and CU-UP interactions within a 5G/4G radio network software stack.

classes.name: pdcp_sdap_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between PDCP and SDAP, handles SDAP PDUs.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_cu_up_mngr_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between PDCP Rx and E1AP, manages control notifications and errors.

classes.name: pdcp_f1u_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between PDCP and F1-U, handles data PDUs and discard commands.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_cu_up_mngr_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between PDCP Tx and E1AP, manages control notifications and errors.

methods.name: connect_sdap
methods.description: Connects an SDAP handler to the PDCP-SDAP adapter.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU received from PDCP, forwards to SDAP handler.

methods.name: connect_cu_up_mngr
methods.description: Connects CU-UP manager to the adapter with UE index.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Handles protocol failure notification, logs warning.

methods.name: on_integrity_failure
methods.description: Handles integrity failure notification, logs warning.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Handles max count reached event, forwards to CU-UP manager.

methods.name: on_resume_required
methods.description: Handles resume required event, forwards to CU-UP manager.

methods.name: connect_f1u
methods.description: Connects F1-U handler to the PDCP-F1U adapter.

methods.name: disconnect_f1u
methods.description: Disconnects F1-U handler from the adapter.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU from PDCP, forwards to F1-U handler.

methods.name: on_discard_pdu
methods.description: Handles discard PDU command, forwards to F1-U handler.

methods.name: connect_cu_up_mngr
methods.description: Connects CU-UP manager to the PDCP Tx adapter with UE index.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Handles protocol failure notification, logs warning.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Handles max count reached event, forwards to CU-UP manager.

methods.name: on_resume_required
methods.description: Handles resume required event, forwards to CU-UP manager.
